把别的 CAD 导出的 STEP 文件 (.step / .stp) 读进来当作: Reads a STEP file (.step / .stp) exported from another CAD program as a solid; you can keep cutting, drilling and filleting it. The document stores only the file path and rereads the file on every rebuild, so changes to the file show up after a rebuild. Surface-only STEP files (e.g. SOLIDWORKS surface exports) are sewn into solids first, and missing planar faces are filled in.
